posts.author: UmbrotheUmbreon
posts.body:
I'm doing an experiment with the idea of using a single party member for a game. I wanted the player to be able to act twice, so that you can use an item/status skill and attack. I thought that Action Time was the solution, but realized it has you choose your options first THEN executes all actions. What I'm looking for is the player is allowed to use items/using a status skill before attacking/guarding. A great example of this kind of thing is West of Loathing/Shadows Over Loathing games, where you can use an item and a skill before attacking. However, Action Times+ lets you do any actions you want twice, so it means the player can attack and guard or use Fireball and Basic Attack, but that's not what I want to happen.
The Engine I'm using is RPG Maker MV, I currently have HIME's ACTOR_BATTLE_COMMANDS/USE_SKILL plugins installed. I figure this might need a plugin, but I also could just be missing something very basic (as my silly small brain does sometimes).

posts.author: JohnDoeGames
posts.body:
You could fake it by giving the enemies an action only once every other turn, by making use of smart ways to set their skills.
All you need to do is make sure ALL the first turns are even (0 = even) or ALL are odd, while the multiplier is ALWAYS even.
Then the enemy will always skip 1 turn.
Want an even slower enemy? Make it skip 2 turns. Make sure all skills start at the same turn-table (1,4,7,10 or 2,5,8,11 or 0,3,6,9) and make the multiplier always dividable by 3.
However....

Certainly a neat suggestion, but unfortunately doesn't actually solve the problem I have. If this set up just simply "skips" the enemy's turn, you'll still be able to do two Attack Actions instead of one skill/item action and then your attack action. If I were to do your work around, without letting the player just simply attack twice, I'd have to code in for HIME's plugin to disable the attack option, but re-enable it after using an item/skill. The battle system would be very limited at that point, forcing the player to use skills/items beforehand, whether they want to or not. It'd delay the process much longer grinding for items, and prevents players from conserving MP/items. I do appreciate the suggestion, but unless I'm misunderstanding something, it seems no different than the Action Time+ and won't work for what I'm going for.
